country.name: El Salvador
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Nawat and other Indigenous language and cultural requirements require review with competent communities and public authorities; machine translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Salvadoran reviewer, current authoritative sources and review of the responsible national, departmental, institutional or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: El Salvador combines MINEDUCYT authority over the national education system, territorial administration, school records and higher-education legal status with separate authorization of degree programs and voluntary institutional accreditation.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: Ministerio de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología (MINEDUCYT)
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the center code, sector, level, territorial location and source publication date.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Legal establishment, authorization of a particular degree program, title registration and voluntary accreditation are distinct claims and require separate evidence.

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología
authorities.role: national education authority, curriculum, school records and higher-education regulation

authorities.name: Dirección Nacional de Educación Superior
authorities.role: higher-education legal status, authorized programs and academic record services

authorities.name: Comisión de Acreditación de la Calidad de la Educación Superior
authorities.role: voluntary institutional accreditation within the higher-education quality system

authorities.name: Agencia de Ciberseguridad del Estado
authorities.role: data-protection rector and supervisory authority under the current legal framework

authorities.name: Consejo Nacional de la Primera Infancia, Niñez y Adolescencia

curriculum.authority: Ministerio de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología
curriculum.title: Programas de estudio, curricular materials and current implementation guidance
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm subject, grade or cycle, publication version, effective date and current pedagogical guidance before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never silently replace the current official program and implementation guidance.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministerio de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The public directory page records a publication date. BRASA must display that date, seek the newest official record, and must not infer present operation or authorization of every service from an older listing.

educationStatistics.authority: Ministerio de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display reporting year, update date, measure, population, source and applicable filters. Historical figures must not be presented as current.

higherEducation.regulatoryAuthority: Dirección Nacional de Educación Superior, MINEDUCYT
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Legal establishment, authorization of a named program, title registration and voluntary accreditation are distinct. Each claim must identify the institution or program, decision, date and current status.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionNotice: The 2026 reform summary identifies the current data-subject rights process and ACE supervisory role. The consolidated law, commencement, regulations and institutional duties require review from the official text before compliance claims.
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Data protection, child rights, consent, safeguarding, incident handling and institutional protocols require qualified review before real learner participation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Salvadoran education reviewer is named.
MINEDUCYT national and territorial implementation responsibilities are reviewed.
Every school record preserves center code, sector, level, source publication date and review date.
Every statistic shows reporting year, update date, definition, population and provenance.
Every higher-education claim distinguishes legal establishment, program authorization, title registration and voluntary accreditation.
Curriculum mappings identify subject, grade or cycle, version, effective date and current guidance.
Nawat and Indigenous cultural requirements are reviewed with competent community participation.
The consolidated personal-data law, 2026 reforms, regulations and ACE arrangements are reviewed by qualified Salvadoran counsel.
Privacy, child protection, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by the participating institution.
No authorization, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
